en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5434 - Muhammad ibn Al-Fuḍayl narrated from Abu Al-Ṣabah Al-Kinani, who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) about the saying of Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic:

"O' you who believe! Witnesses between you when death approaches one of you, at the time of bequest, are two just men from among you, or two others from outside of you."
(Surah Al-Ma'idah 5:106)

Imam (as) said: "They are two disbelievers."
I asked: "Two just men from among you?"
Imam (as) said: "They are two Muslims."
